correctness.rationale: The C++17 code enumerates all distinct restricted-growth proper partitions with one through eight classes on exactly 14 labeled vertices, tests every vertex against every class by open-neighborhood inclusion, and proves no smaller valid coloring plus 2751 optimal partitions. Its complete one-vertex-move enumeration/BFS yields 11662 edges, 21 isolates and two larger components of 966 and 1764. Independently the Python program enumerates all 877 Fano-side partitions, valid one-to-one nonincident class mergers and the same complete graph, reproducing the full 2401/322/28 mixed breakdown, components and degree histogram and checking 21 flags. Both were run successfully from the actual provided source paths. The proof explains why both finite encodings are complete, rather than mistaking partial sampling for a proof. No infinite extension is asserted.

originality.rationale: The 2013 origin and 2024 scalar minimum are expressly credited. The full relevant 2024 Section 4 proof determines only the least number of classes, not the complete 2751 unlabelled optimum partitions, their 350 mixed cases, or 11662 single-vertex exchanges with 23 components. Three especially close mathematical archive claims were inspected as complete research statements: class-first dominated coloring (opposite quantifier), four-fold total dominating witness systems (overlapping sets rather than proper partitions), and ordinary three-color recoloring (different palette and predicate). Their statements and results do not imply the new census or exchange graph. Targeted literature and mathematical-result searches yielded no covering claim. Residual unindexed-priority risk remains.
residual_risks: Mathematical publication priority cannot exclude an unindexed exact Heawood TDC enumeration under different terminology.
Henning 2015 full text was not accessed; only its abstract, so it is not designated as fully NOT_COVERING.
Other journal supplements, theses or unpublished enumerations might give equivalent finite optimizer data.
These are priority/access risks, not evidence of incorrect finite counts; independent external scholarly validation has not occurred.

value.rationale: The previously known eight-color minimum leaves a nontrivial and naturally motivated optimizer landscape on the unique cubic girth-six cage. The new complete count distinguishes 350 optimal mixed classes (which cannot themselves witness total domination) from 2401 unmixed optima, and resolves all single-vertex transitions into 21 rigid incidence flags plus two large sectors with distinct geometry. This is a meaningful finite classification and sharp stability/mobility boundary for a standard graph and graph-coloring invariant; it does not rest on code correctness or numerical novelty alone.
